item.title: STUNT Advances to NCAA Championship Sport Status - USA Cheer
item.description: Historic milestone marks culmination of 16+ year journey to create a collegiate sport derived from cheer and designed for women DALLAS, TX, UNITED STATES, January 20, 2026 – STUNT, the head-to-head competitive cheer sport governed nationally by USA Cheer, has officially advanced to NCAA Championship Sport status, marking a historic milestone for women’s collegiate athletics. item.title: Healthy Teeth, Healthy Athlete: 3 Things Parents Should Know About Oral Health - USA Cheer
item.description: As an athlete, you know that not every competition will end with a win. In fact, there will almost always be something in a race, competition, or match that doesn't go your way. That can be emotionally difficult, but even in these challenging moments, sportsmanship is critical. Lack of sportsmanship can have long-term effects on your mental wellbeing and your success on teams, as well as lead to coaches not wanting to recruit or retain you in the future.
